limitations.note: The patch fixed the one-cycle output delay but dropped the explicit reset override and replaced the conditional decode with equality assignments, which can produce unknown outputs instead of zero when the state is uninitialized.

The test first checked reset outputs after a high-to-low reset pulse had time to set the state to idle, so it could not distinguish explicit output reset gating from clearing the outputs indirectly through the state.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire test launch to be rejected before simulation, so the agent had to resubmit it with different cleanup.
